reuse.why: The consumers share the new helper, but it sidesteps the existing getScheduledAmount abstraction and reimplements getApproxNumberThreshold.

duplication.why: The diff consolidates several callers but duplicates the existing amount dispatch and approximate-tolerance calculation.

placement.why: Schedule amount policy belongs in shared/schedules.ts, with API conversion remaining in api-models.ts.

scope.why: All edits concern schedule amount calculation, its API exposure, or focused tests.

maintainability.why: Nearly identical helper names now represent competing amount policies, while existing UI consumers and budget templates retain separate definitions.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts adds getScheduleAmount alongside getScheduledAmount and calculates tolerance directly instead of calling shared/rules.ts:getApproxNumberThreshold.

disguised_duplication.where: getScheduleAmount reshapes getScheduledAmount's missing/number/range dispatch under a nearly identical name, and its local tolerance expression reproduces getApproxNumberThreshold.

abstraction_drift.where: The new parallel helper introduces amountOp and an isapprox branch; API conversion, forecast normalization, action synchronization, posting, and previews call it instead of extending the existing getScheduledAmount abstraction.
